description: Exports ONE user data type (UDT) as SimaticML XML and returns it INLINE with sha256, normalizedSha256 and bytes — hashed exactly like tia_export_block, no file on the serve host. `contentHash` is the stale-write guard hash, defined as in tia_export_block (SHA-256 of the default-options export with volatile noise removed and UIds renumbered canonically; it exists only for a well-formed XML export: otherwise the XML is still returned, `contentHash` is absent and `contentHashError` says why). `contentHash`, `normalizedSha256` and `sha256` are different hash contracts over different normalizations: never substitute one for another, and pass only the `contentHash` of a fresh read as `expectedContentHash`. Pass the `contentHash` as `expectedContentHash` to tia_types_import and the write is refused with 409 state_changed if the type changed in the project after this read (an existing type whose current export is not well-formed XML is refused with 409 unverifiable); an older serve returns no contentHash. It never compiles: a type that is not consistent is refused with 409 inconsistent (compile the PLC first with tia_compile) and an unknown type with 404 not_found (exact name first, then ignoring case). Maps to GET /plcs/{plc}/types/{type}/xml. Class R. Long operation: may answer status:"running" + jobId — then call tia_job_status.
name: tia_export_type
title: TIA — export one type/UDT (SimaticML, inline)
